title: National passenger-route suspension by transport operators
reason: The search-only reports describe a route/service suspension or transport strike, not an evidenced public gathering of at least 50 people. Route and vehicle counts cannot be treated as attendee counts.
notes: APOTA and transport operators opposed CNESP capacity restrictions and sought state support. A reported 1,500 vehicles refers to service units, not people. The February 23 action is retained as an exclusion, not pooled with any city protest.

title: Planned Chișinău gathering opposing a Dodon–Șor government
reason: The municipal register is a planned-event listing for 49 people, below the 50-person threshold, and no source verifies that it occurred.
notes: The notice is retained as a lead only; it is not counted as an observed February protest.

title: Ungheni railway workers’ wage ultimatum
reason: Available search-only descriptions report an ultimatum by rail employees but provide no evidence of a public gathering.
notes: Kept as an adjacent workplace-action lead, not coded as a February public protest. The publication date for S014 does not establish the ultimatum’s event date.
